motion.name: card-reveal
motion.purpose: Brief rotation on a newly revealed card; disabled for reduced motion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Olive action for starting, confirming, and entering a game.

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Ruled option for canceling or passing.

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Light field with a visible ochre keyboard focus.

components.name: Game Navigation
components.description: Compact masthead with brand and quiet game actions.

components.name: Score Tile
components.description: Team badge, name, action status, and remaining count.
components.css: .ds-score{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;min-width:220px;padding:14px;border:1px solid var(--line,#c9cbbd);border-radius:6px;outline:2px solid #a93f36;outline-offset:-2px;background:var(--surface,#faf8f2);color:var(--ink,#222c25);font:400 .88rem "DM Sans",sans-serif}.ds-letter{display:grid;place-items:center;width:36px;height:36px;border-radius:4px;background:#a93f36;color:#fff;font-weight:700}.ds-score strong,.ds-score small{display:block}.ds-score small{color:var(--muted,#596154);font-size:.64rem}.ds-score b{margin-left:auto;font:600 2.2rem "Barlow Condensed",sans-serif}

components.name: Word Card
components.description: Five-column board card with a dominant noun; longer Italian words hyphenate on mobile and known ownership remains explicit.
components.css: .ds-word-card{position:relative;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;width:180px;height:110px;padding:10px 13px;border:1px solid #c0c3b2;border-radius:7px;background:var(--surface,#faf8f2);color:var(--ink,#222c25);cursor:pointer;transition:background-color .2s}.ds-word-card strong{max-width:100%;overflow-wrap:anywhere;font:600 2rem/1 "Barlow Condensed",sans-serif}.ds-index{position:absolute;top:7px;left:10px;color:var(--muted,#596154);font:.53rem "DM Sans",sans-serif}.ds-word-card small{margin-top:10px;font:400 .51rem "DM Sans",sans-serif;letter-spacing:.06em}.ds-word-card:hover{border-color:var(--olive,#52613b);background:#e7eadc}.ds-word-card:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #8a681d;outline-offset:4px}@media(max-width:760px){.ds-word-card{container-type:inline-size}.ds-word-card strong{font-size:clamp(.4rem,calc(155cqw / var(--word-length)),1.4rem);white-space:nowrap;overflow-wrap:normal}.ds-word-card strong.long-word{font-size:clamp(.75rem,3vw,.9rem);line-height:1.08;white-space:normal;hyphens:auto}.ds-word-card small{display:none}}

components.name: Reveal Dialog
components.description: Focused confirmation surface for an irreversible reveal.
components.html:
Conferma la scelta

components.css: .ds-dialog{width:320px;padding:28px;border-radius:12px;background:var(--surface,#faf8f2);box-shadow:0 18px 60px #15201840;color:var(--ink,#222c25);font-family:"DM Sans",sans-serif}.ds-dialog small{color:var(--muted,#596154)}.ds-dialog h2{margin:10px 0 20px;font:600 3.2rem "Barlow Condensed",sans-serif}.ds-dialog p{font-size:.85rem;color:var(--muted,#596154)}.ds-dialog button{min-height:44px;padding:12px 18px;border:0;border-radius:5px;background:var(--olive,#52613b);color:#fff;font:600 .85rem "DM Sans",sans-serif}.ds-dialog button:hover{filter:brightness(.95)}.ds-dialog button:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #8a681d;outline-offset:4px}

narrative.overview:
The interface reads as an ivory working surface for a game run in the same room. It favors rules, compact controls, numbered positions, and clearly named team ownership over decorative espionage imagery. The board is the visual center in play; setup keeps configuration and its live allocation preview in view together.

The public board must remain readable when projected, while the Spymaster map uses the same card geometry on a phone. Functional labels carry status alongside color. Card revelation is the expressive moment: a brief tilt gives way to a persistent ownership label, strike, and check. Reduced motion removes the animation.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper and light card surfaces with dark green ink.
Olive actions and five named team colors.
Condensed, large game words paired with quiet sans-serif controls.
Flat rules and outlines, with depth reserved for floating layers.

rules.name: The Named Ownership Rule
rules.body: Never communicate a card's owner or active team by hue alone; show the name, letter, or status text with it.

rules.name: The Word First Rule
rules.body: On the board, the noun receives the strongest type treatment; index and ownership remain visible but secondary.

rules.name: The Flat Table Rule
rules.body: Keep board cards and score tiles free of resting shadows; use outlines and fills to express their state.

dos: Do keep word cards in five aligned columns on public and Spymaster boards.
Do pair team colors with visible names, letters, and status text.
Do preserve the 44px minimum for interactive controls and the visible keyboard focus outline.
Do provide a reduced-motion path for card revelation.
donts: Don't put resting shadows on word cards or score tiles.
Don't replace the operational table with decorative spy graphics or fake telemetry.
Don't make ownership, turn, or elimination status depend on color alone.
